ayahs.textUthmani: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قٓ‌ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: ق࢜ࣞۚ وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْمَجِيْدِ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Qāf.[1524] By the honored Qur’ān...[1525]
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaf wal-qur'aanil-majeed
ayahs.translationClear: Qaf. By the Glorious Quran.

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلْ عَجِبُوْٓا اَنْ جَا࢜ءَهُمْ مُّنْذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ هٰذَا شَيْءٌ عَجِيْبٌ ۚ
ayahs.translation: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
ayahs.transliteration: Bal 'ajiboo an jaa'ahum mundhirum minhum faqaalal-kaafiroona haadhaa shay'un 'ajeeb
ayahs.translationClear: They marveled that a warner has come to them from among them. The disbelievers say, “This is something strange.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا‌ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: ءَاِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًاۚ ذٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."
ayahs.transliteration: A'idhaa mitnaa wakunnaa turaaban dhaalika raj'um ba'eed
ayahs.translationClear: When we have died and become dust? This is a farfetched return.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَـٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ‌ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَـٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنْقُصُ الْاَرْضُ مِنْهُمْۚ وَعِنْدَنَا كِتٰبٌ حَفِيْظٌ
ayahs.translation: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
ayahs.transliteration: Qad 'alimnaa maa tanqusul-ardu minhum wa'indanaa kitaabun hafeez
ayahs.translationClear: We know what the earth consumes of them, and with Us is a comprehensive book.

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَا࢜ءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيْٓ اَمْرٍ مَّرِيْجٍ
ayahs.translation: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
ayahs.transliteration: Bal kadhdhaboo bil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum fahum fee amrim mareej
ayahs.translationClear: But they denied the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اَفَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوْٓا اِلَي السَّمَا࢜ءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنٰهَا وَزَيَّنّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِنْ فُرُوْجٍ
ayahs.translation: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
ayahs.transliteration: Afalam yanzuroo ilas-samaa'i fawqahum kayfa banaynaahaa wazayyannaahaa wamaa lahaa min furooj
ayahs.translationClear: Have they not observed the sky above them, how We constructed it, and decorated it, and it has no cracks?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالْاَرْضَ مَدَدْنٰهَا وَاَلْقَيْنَا فِيْهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَاَنۢ͏ْبَتْنَا فِيْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ بَهِيْجٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-arda madadnaahaa wa'alqaynaa feehaa rawaasiya wa'ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjim baheej
ayahs.translationClear: And the earth, how We spread it out, and set on it mountains, and grew in it all kinds of delightful pairs?

ayahs.textUthmani: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: تَبْصِرَةً وَّذِكْرٰي لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيْبٍ
ayahs.translation: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Tabsiratan wadhikraa likulli 'abdim muneeb
ayahs.translationClear: A lesson and a reminder for every penitent worshiper.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَـٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَـٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ مَا࢜ءً مُّبٰرَكًا فَاَنۢ͏ْبَتْنَا بِهٖ جَنّٰتٍ وَّحَبَّ الْحَصِيْدِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
ayahs.transliteration: Wanazzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'am mubaarakan fa'ambatnaa bihee jannaatin wahabbal-haseed
ayahs.translationClear: And We brought down from the sky blessed water, and produced with it gardens and grain to harvest.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالنَّخْلَ بٰسِقٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيْدٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
ayahs.transliteration: Wan-nakhla baasiqaatil lahaa tal'un nadeed
ayahs.translationClear: And the soaring palm trees, with clustered dates.

ayahs.textUthmani: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ‌ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِۙ وَاَحْيَيْنَا بِهٖ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًاؕ كَذٰلِكَ الْخُرُوْجُ
ayahs.translation: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].
ayahs.transliteration: Rizqal lil'ibaadi wa'ahyaynaa bihee baldatam maytan kadhaalikal-khurooj
ayahs.translationClear: As sustenance for the servants. And We revive thereby a dead town. Likewise is the Resurrection.

ayahs.textUthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ وَّاَصْحٰبُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمُوْدُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: The people of Noah denied before them,[1526] and the companions of the well[1527] and Thamūd
ayahs.transliteration: Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohin wa'as'haabur-rassi wathamood

footnotes.1526: i.e., before the disbelievers of Makkah.

ayahs.translationClear: Before them the people of Noah denied the truth, and so did the dwellers of Russ, and Thamood.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَعَادٌ وَّفِرْعَوْنُ وَاِخْوَانُ لُوْطٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'aadun wafir'awnu wa'ikhwaanu loot
ayahs.translationClear: And Aad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ‌ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَصْحٰبُ الْاَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍؕ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيْدِ
ayahs.translation: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'as'haabul-aykati waqawmu tubba'in kullun kadhdhabar-rusula fahaqqa wa'eed
ayahs.translationClear: And the dwellers of the Woods, and the people of Tubba. They all rejected the messengers, so My threat came true.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ‌ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَفَعَيِيْنَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْاَوَّلِؕ بَلْ هُمْ فِيْ لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيْدٍ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
ayahs.transliteration: Afa'ayeenaa bil-khalqil-awwali bal hum fee labsim min khalqin jadeed
ayahs.translationClear: Were We fatigued by the first creation? But they are in doubt of a new creation.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ‌ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهٖ نَفْسُهٗۚۖ وَنَحْنُ اَقْرَبُ اِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيْدِ
ayahs.translation: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer[1528] to him than [his] jugular vein.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqnal-insaana wana'lamu maa tuwaswisu bihee nafsuhoo wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi min hablil-wareed

footnotes.1528: In absolute knowledge of everything about him. "We" has also been interpreted to mean the angels who are mentioned in the following verse.

ayahs.translationClear: We created the human being, and We know what his soul whispers to him. We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ يَتَلَقَّي الْمُتَلَقِّيٰنِ عَنِ الْيَمِيْنِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive,[1529] seated on the right and on the left.
ayahs.transliteration: Idh yatalaqqal-mutalaqqiyaani 'anil-yameeni wa'anish-shimaali qa'eed

footnotes.1529: And record each word and deed.

ayahs.translationClear: As the two receivers receive, seated to the right and to the left.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ اِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيْبٌ عَتِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
ayahs.transliteration: Maa yalfizu min qawlin illaa ladayhi raqeebun 'ateed
ayahs.translationClear: Not a word does he utter, but there is a watcher by him, ready.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ‌ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَا࢜ءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّؕ ذٰلِكَ مَا كُنْتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيْدُ
ayahs.translation: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
ayahs.transliteration: Wajaa'at sakratul-mawti bil-haqqi dhaalika maa kunta minhu taheed
ayahs.translationClear: The daze of death has come in truth: “This is what you tried to evade.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّوْرِؕ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْوَعِيْدِ
ayahs.translation: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
ayahs.transliteration: Wanufikha fis-soori dhaalika yawmul-wa'eed
ayahs.translationClear: And the Trumpet is blown: “This is the Promised Day.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَا࢜ءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَا࢜ىِٕقٌ وَّشَهِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.[1530]
ayahs.transliteration: Wajaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saa'iqun washaheed

footnotes.1530: i.e., one angel driving the soul to the Judgement and one to testify as to its deeds.

ayahs.translationClear: And every soul will come forward, accompanied by a driver and a witness.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: لَقَدْ كُنْتَ فِيْ غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنْكَ غِطَا࢜ءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover,[1531] so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad kunta fee ghaflatim min haadhaa fakashafnaa 'anka ghitaa'aka fabasarukal-yawma hadeed

footnotes.1531: Of heedlessness, or that which had sealed your hearing, your vision and your heart from guidance.

ayahs.translationClear: “You were in neglect of this, so We lifted your screen from you, and your vision today is keen.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالَ قَرِيْنُهٗ هٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيْدٌ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaala qareenuhoo haadhaa maa ladayya 'ateed
ayahs.translationClear: And his escort will say, “This is what I have ready with me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلْقِيَا فِيْ جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيْدٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
ayahs.transliteration: Alqiyaa fee jahannama kulla kaffaarin 'aneed
ayahs.translationClear: “Throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيْبِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
ayahs.transliteration: Mannaa'il lilkhayri mu'tadim mureeb
ayahs.translationClear: Preventer of good, aggressor, doubter.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اࣙلَّذِيْ جَعَلَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَاَلْقِيٰهُ فِي الْعَذَابِ الشَّدِيْدِ
ayahs.translation: Who made [as equal] with Allāh another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladhee ja'ala ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara fa'alqiyaahu fil-'adhaabish-shadeed
ayahs.translationClear: Who fabricated another god with Allah; toss him into the intense agony.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ قَرِيْنُهٗ رَبَّنَا مَا͏ٓ اَطْغَيْتُهٗ وَلٰكِنْ كَانَ فِيْ ضَلٰلٍۢ بَعِيْدٍ
ayahs.translation: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala qareenuhoo rabbanaa maa atghaytuhoo walaakin kaana fee dalaalim ba'eed
ayahs.translationClear: His escort will say, “Our Lord, I did not make him rebel, but he was far astray.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوْا لَدَيَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ اِلَيْكُمْ بِالْوَعِيْدِ
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala laa takhtasimoo ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bil-wa'eed
ayahs.translationClear: He will say, “Do not feud in My presence—I had warned you in advance.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَا͏ٓ اَنَا بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيْدِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
ayahs.transliteration: Maa yubaddalul-qawlu ladayya wamaa ana bizallaamil lil'abeed
ayahs.translationClear: The decree from Me will not be changed, and I am not unjust to the servants.”

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ نَقُوْلُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلَاْتِ وَتَقُوْلُ هَلْ مِنْ مَّزِيْدٍ
ayahs.translation: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma naqoolu lijahannama halimtala'ti wataqoolu hal mim mazeed
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when We will say to Hell, “Are you full?” And it will say, “Are there any more?”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ غَيْرَ بَعِيْدٍ
ayahs.translation: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'uzlifatil-jannatu lilmuttaqeena ghayra ba'eed
ayahs.translationClear: And Paradise will be brought closer to the pious, not far away.

ayahs.textUthmani: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: هٰذَا مَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لِكُلِّ اَوَّابٍ حَفِيْظٍ ۚ
ayahs.translation: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].
ayahs.transliteration: Haadhaa maa too'adoona likulli awwaabin hafeez
ayahs.translationClear: “This is what you were promised—for every careful penitent.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: مَنْ خَشِيَ الرَّحْمٰنَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَجَا࢜ءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيْبِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
ayahs.transliteration: Man khashiyar-rahmaana bil-ghaybi wajaa'a biqalbim muneeb
ayahs.translationClear: Who inwardly feared the Most Gracious, and came with a repentant heart.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ‌ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اࣙدْخُلُوْهَا بِسَلٰمٍؕ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُلُوْدِ
ayahs.translation: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
ayahs.transliteration: Udkhuloohaa bisalaamin dhaalika yawmul-khulood
ayahs.translationClear: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity.”

ayahs.textUthmani: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: لَهُمْ مَّا يَشَا࢜ءُوْنَ فِيْهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
ayahs.transliteration: Lahum maa yashaa'oona feehaa waladaynaa mazeed
ayahs.translationClear: Therein they will have whatever they desire—and We have even more.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ اَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوْا فِي الْبِلَادِؕ هَلْ مِنْ مَّحِيْصٍ
ayahs.translation: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
ayahs.transliteration: Wakam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fil-bilaadi hal mim mahees
ayahs.translationClear: How many generations before them, who were more powerful than they, did We destroy? They explored the lands—was there any escape?

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرٰي لِمَنْ كَانَ لَهٗ قَلْبٌ اَوْ اَلْقَي السَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
ayahs.transliteration: Inna fee dhaalika ladhikraa liman kaana lahoo qalbun aw alqas-sam'a wahuwa shaheed
ayahs.translationClear: In that is a reminder for whoever possesses a heart, or cares to listen and witness.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِيْ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍࣗۖ وَّمَا مَسَّنَا مِنْ لُّغُوْبٍ
ayahs.translation: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin wamaa massanaa mil lughoob
ayahs.translationClear: We created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days, and no fatigue touched Us.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاصْبِرْ عَلٰي مَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوْعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوْبِ ۚ
ayahs.translation: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
ayahs.transliteration: Fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tuloo'ish-shamsi waqablal-ghuroob
ayahs.translationClear: So endure what they say, and proclaim the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun, and before sunset.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَاَدْبَارَ السُّجُوْدِ
ayahs.translation: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].
ayahs.transliteration: Waminal-layli fasabbihhu wa'adbaaras-sujood
ayahs.translationClear: And glorify Him during the night, and at the end of devotions.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ مِنْ مَّكَانٍ قَرِيْبٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And listen on the Day when the Caller[1532] will call out from a place that is near -
ayahs.transliteration: Wastami' yawma yunaadil-munaadi mim makaanin qareeb

footnotes.1532: An angel who will call out Allāh's command for the Resurrection.

ayahs.translationClear: And listen for the Day when the caller calls from a nearby place.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: يَّوْمَ يَسْمَعُوْنَ الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّؕ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُرُوْجِ
ayahs.translation: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma yasma'oonas-sayhata bil-haqqi dhaalika yawmul-khurooj
ayahs.translationClear: The Day when they will hear the Shout in all truth. That is the Day of Emergence.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيٖ وَنُمِيْتُ وَاِلَيْنَا الْمَصِيْرُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa nahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wa'ilaynal-maseer
ayahs.translationClear: It is We who control life and death, and to Us is the destination.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ الْاَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًاؕ ذٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma tashaqqaqul-ardu 'anhum siraa'an dhaalika hashrun 'alaynaa yaseer
ayahs.translationClear: The Day when the earth will crack for them at once. That is an easy gathering for Us.

ayahs.textUthmani: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ‌ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ‌ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: نَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِجَبَّارٍࣞ فَذَكِّرْ بِالْقُرْاٰنِ مَنْ يَّخَافُ وَعِيْدِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant.[1533] But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
ayahs.transliteration: Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona wamaa anta 'alayhim bijabbaarin fadhakkir bil-qur'aani man yakhaafu wa'eed

footnotes.1533: Forcing people to belief or submission.

ayahs.translationClear: We are fully aware of what they say, and you are not a dictator over them. So remind by the Quran whoever fears My warning.
